selected_route: Still Learning Love In Real Time
selector_rationale: Turns the contradiction mechanic into visible couple repair: tone, listening, space, tea, late-night repair, morning softness.

rejected_routes.name: Two People, One Pattern
rejected_routes.why: Relatable but less visual; risks becoming a text spine.

rejected_routes.name: Healthy Love Has Bad Days
rejected_routes.why: Strong truth, weaker ownable Aachu/Zuv evidence.

rejected_routes.name: Apology As Tea
rejected_routes.why: Beautiful beat, too narrow for a full deck by itself.

rejected_routes.name: Door Half Open
rejected_routes.why: Excellent image, but would over-index on one metaphor.

rejected_routes.name: Love Notices Sooner
rejected_routes.why: Strong payoff, but chosen route has a better swipe ladder.

stage_scene_gate.action: The couple moves through a small fight: distance, a too-firm cup, listening poorly, asking for space, offering tea, repairing at night, returning softer in the morning.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Each slide shows the body reacting before the moral arrives: still-angled feet, frozen hands, held breath, half-open door, lowered eyes, tired closeness, morning touch.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Eye-lines shift from avoidance to partial attention to direct soft return by the final slide.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Cup set down, napkin/phone gripped, door left ajar, tea placed beside a hand, blanket or shared mess repaired, two cups together by morning.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The strongest beats are pauses: after the fight, before the reply, behind the half-open door, and before accepting the tea.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: Sendable to a partner as a gentle 'this is us when we are trying' mirror, especially after small fights or apology moments.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The carousel moves from confession of imperfection to proof that awareness can become tenderness in the very next ordinary action.

font_lock: Typography override from supplied screenshots: rounded, imperfect, airy handwritten lowercase; uneven human spacing; warm white ink on dark scenes and warm charcoal on light scenes; integrated into the artwork, never UI or quote-card type.

structure_lock.raw_creator_format_note: better copy supplied 2026-07-03; create fresh images on this; make room for action over words
structure_lock.order_text: Cover -> Cold Open -> Mirror -> Spine -> Rhythm -> Turn -> Payoff
structure_lock.creator_copy_rule: On-image copy is the text before any ~ note, preserved exactly as supplied.
structure_lock.text_generation_rule: Never generate an @a.storyof.two carousel image without exact slide text and the tiny top-right @a.storyof.two brandmark baked into the image itself.

slides.copy:
we talk about healthy love,
but we still learn it mid-fight.
slides.visual: Immediate cover contradiction: Aachu and Zuv are mid-fight in a lived-in room, verbally tense but not cruel. Their bodies are angled away, hands animated, brows tight, with tiny signs they still care: one cup between them, a blanket half-shared, feet still pointed toward each other. Make it active, not quiet poster sadness.
slides.job: Stop the scroll with the honest contradiction and make the fight theme immediately legible.

slides.copy:
we talk about patience,
but sometimes our tone arrives first.
slides.visual: Show the two verbally fighting or sharply talking over each other in a kitchen or small room. One partner points or lifts a hand mid-sentence while the other reacts, a cup/spoon/object landing too hard on the counter. The receipt is tone arriving before patience: visible mouths open, tense hands, not physical aggression.
slides.job: Stage the first specific verbal-fight behavior that proves the contradiction.

slides.copy:
we talk about listening,
but sometimes we just don't listen at all.
slides.visual: Stage a clear not-listening beat: both partners are in the same room but mentally elsewhere, one talking while the other looks away at a phone, cupboard, or floor; or both speak at once with crossed eye-lines. It should feel instantly recognizable: they are hearing sound, not receiving each other.
slides.job: Make viewers recognize how not-listening looks inside a relationship.

slides.copy:
we talk about giving space,
but still always irritate the hell out of each other.
slides.visual: Action over words: one partner tries to get space on a bed, sofa, or floor corner, while the other keeps hovering nearby and irritating them in a petty familiar way: poking, making faces, moving a pillow, tapping the door, or standing too close. Make it funny-irritating, not mean.
slides.job: Carry the truth through familiar irritation and failed space.

slides.copy:
we talk about saying sorry,
but never apologies when we should.
slides.visual: Show the apology failure actively: both partners are close enough to repair but stubbornly not apologizing. One holds a cup or folded arms; the other looks away with a wounded-but-proud face. The apology is available in the room but withheld. No peaceful tea apology; this beat is the stubborn silence after the fight.
slides.job: Repeat the contradiction through the stubborn apology gap.

slides.copy:
we talk about forever,
but we fight like we don't know each other.
slides.visual: The strongest fight receipt: late evening, both tired and emotional, standing/sitting apart like strangers in their own room. Their posture says they know each other deeply, but the fight has made them act unfamiliar. Use distance, crossed eye-lines, scattered blanket/cups, and one small shared object between them.
slides.job: Sharpen the reversal: forever-talk versus stranger-like fighting.

slides.copy:
maybe love is noticing the pattern,
and choosing softness sooner.
slides.visual: Morning-after or after-fight payoff: the fight energy softens through action, not a grand hug. One partner reaches first, adjusts a blanket, moves closer, or offers a small touch; the other accepts. The room still has traces of the fight, but the body language shows they noticed the pattern sooner.
slides.job: Land the saveable lesson through a visible choice toward softness.

creator_copy_revision.theme: healthy love still fights badly, but learns to soften sooner
creator_copy_revision.action_directive: make room for action over words
